MACHINING ALLOWANCES:
- IF THE SEALING SURFACES OF ANY CHECK VALVE 
COMPONENT CANNOT BE RESTORED BY LAPPING, THE 
PARTS CAN BE MACHINED FLAT PRIOR TO LAPPING. 
- ENSURE ONLY THE SEALING SURFACE IS MACHINED, 
AND THE PERPENDICULARITY BETWEEN THE MACHINED 
FACE AND THE COMPONENT AXIS IS MAINTAINED.
- ENSURE THE MINIMUM DIMENSIONS AND FINISHES ARE 
MAINTAINED.
- AFTER MACHINING, COMPONENTS MUST BE LAPPED 
FOLLOWING STANDARD LAPPING PROCEDURE.
